subtopics.title: Model-View-Template (MVT) Architecture in Django
subtopics.description: Explore the MVT architecture in Django, including the role of models, views, and templates. Understand how to define models in Django, create views to handle HTTP requests, and configure templates for rendering the final output. Dive into the basics of Django’s ORM (Object-Relational Mapping) and how to interact with databases using models.
